### Copilot Instructions

### School Overview

- The school name is "Mergington High School"
- The school is a public high school in Mergington, Florida.
- The school motto is "Branch out and grow".
- It serves grades 9 through 12 and typically has 100 to 150 students per grade.

### Development Environment

For setup and local development, use the guide in `docs/how-to-develop.md`.

### User Interaction

- The school staff is not highly technical, so keep explanations simple and avoid jargon.
- Prefer maintainable and easy-to-understand implementations.

### Program Architecture

- Keep this as a single web app for students and teachers.
- Do not add extra apps, services, or CLI tools.
- Use only HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python.

### Documentation

- Update README documentation when behavior or features change.

### Security

- Avoid hardcoding secrets, credentials, or sensitive values.
- If authentication is required, use proper login/logout UX and safe storage.
